environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and codebase deployed in the production account. The RDS PostgreSQL instance connection is established using IAM database authentication with a scoped policy. The pg_hba.conf enforces SSL and the database role 'order_processor_ro' is configured via a Terraform-managed grants module (terraform-aws-modules/rds v5.x) with explicit privilege set. The role was created with: CREATE ROLE order_processor_ro WITH LOGIN; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, orders TO order_processor_ro; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO order_processor_ro; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA orders TO order_processor_ro; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public, orders GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO order_processor_ro; No additional grants exist. The RDS instance has a parameter group with log_statement=ddl and pgaudit.log='write'. An SCP on the OU prevents rds:ModifyDBCluster actions except from the infrastructure automation role.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public, orders TO order_processor_ro (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE)
config.network: VPC with private subnet, RDS in same VPC, no public access
